responsibility: Defines Rust HIR data structures for paths and generic arguments across expressions, patterns, types, and visibility restrictions. It models identifier segments, generic argument bindings and const arguments, generic-argument lists, qualified path types, path expressions, qualified paths in expressions and types, and the simplified SimplePath representation used by constructs such as restricted visibility. This file owns the reusable path vocabulary that other HIR node families embed rather than higher-level item or expression semantics.
